```{.quiz-yaml}
id: 12_independent_t_variability
title: >
  Calculate Variability
questions:
  - id: pooled_variance
    type: numeric
    prompt: >
      Two independent samples each have n = 5. Their variances are 4 and 10. What is
      the pooled variance?
    answer: 7
    tolerance: 0.01
    explanation: >
      With equal sample sizes, the pooled variance is the average of the two
      variances: 7. More generally, weight by degrees of freedom.
```
